cj: Quick heads-up — eu-west GPU node pools are horribly imbalanced. Cluster-autoscaler kept launching nodes in eu-west-1a only, leaving eu-west-1b/c empty. A bunch of gpu pods are Pending with `Insufficient GPUs`.
linh: Ugh. Seen similar when ENI/ip exhaustion or wrong expander settings. Can you paste `kubectl get pods -o wide` for a couple of Pending ones and the node labels?

cj: Pasting trimmed output:
```
NAME                       READY   STATUS    NODE           NAMESPACE   NODE-SELECTOR
gpu-trainer-0              0/1     Pending   <none>         ml          kubernetes.io/instance-type=g5.xlarge
gpu-trainer-1              0/1     Pending   <none>         ml          kubernetes.io/instance-type=g5.xlarge
```
And nodes we do have:
```
ip-10-0-12-34.eu-west-1.compute.internal   Ready    g5.xlarge   eu-west-1a
ip-10-0-23-45.eu-west-1.compute.internal   Ready    g5.xlarge   eu-west-1a
```
Only az-a has GPU nodes.

sanjay: This is the terraform managed nodepool we rolled out last week, right? The one with spot=true?

cj: Yep, module `gpu-nodepool` in infra repo. Desired 4, max 12, spot enabled.

linh: Two immediate suspects:
1) ENI / IP quota in the subnet(s) for b/c — scheduler can't place pods even if autoscaler wants to.
2) Cluster Autoscaler config: expander, balance-similar-node-groups flags, and `--skip-nodes-with-local-storage` interplay.

linh: Can you run `aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --filters Name=subnet-id,Values=subnet-xxx` and paste attach counts? Also check CA helm values. Example values we prefer:
```
autoDiscovery:
  clusterName: redwood-prod
  tags:
    k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/enabled: "true"
extraArgs:
  expander: least-waste
  balance-similar-node-groups: "true"
  skipNodesWithLocalStorage: "false"
scaleDown:
  delay: 10m
```

cj: Running the ENI check now — looks like eu-west-1b subnet has only 8 free IPs, and our instance type needs a few more for the number of ENIs per node. So autoscaler is preferring az-a where the subnets still have room.

linh: That matches. Two remediation paths:
- Short term: tweak CA to `expander: least-waste` and `balance-similar-node-groups` to force even AZ distribution; bump node group max so CA can provision fallback nodes in other AZs.
- Mid term: update Terraform nodepool module to use multiple subnets evenly and/or request increased IP quota, or switch to `amazon-vpc-cni` config which reduces per-pod IP pressure (or use ENI bridging where applicable).

sanjay: I've got a small terraform patch ready to add `az_distribution = "balanced"` and `max_size = 18` for the module. We'll also add a note to run `aws ec2 request-managed-prefix-list` with infra team if quota hit persists — cost ops will want a heads-up.

cj: For immediate relief I'm going to apply a helm upgrade to cluster-autoscaler in eu-west with the extraArgs change and enable `--balance-similar-node-groups=true`. Command:
```
helm upgrade cluster-autoscaler charts/cluster-autoscaler \
  -n kube-system -f values-eu-west.yaml \
  --set extraArgs.balance-similar-node-groups=true \
  --set extraArgs.expander=least-waste
```

infra-bot: deploy started for helm release `cluster-autoscaler` in kube-system by cj at 1882003520 :rocket:

linh: After the CA change, watch the scale-up pattern and `kube-scheduler` logs. If pods still pending, we'll temporarily cordon problematic subnets and force CA to provision across AZs.

alex: FYI capacity/cost: if the spot pools keep failing and we fall back to on-demand for a few nodes, expect ~10-15% bump on the short-term bill. Ping me once you flip any on-demand fallback so we can notify finance.

cj: Will open two PRs: 1) terraform module change + plan output to review; 2) autoscaler values tweak (helm values file). I'll run the CA canary in eu-west-1 first and monitor for 30m before wider rollout.

linh: Also add a small e2e: create a pod with nodeSelector for g5.xlarge and confirm it lands in b/c after changes. If not, we'll escalate to AWS support for ENI limits.

sanjay: Sounds good. tagging infra-oncall for watch. :eyes:

infra-bot: oncall notified: @infra-oncall at 1882003560

cj: Thanks — I'll post updates here. If anyone sees weird scale-down churn, mute the CA alerts for 1hr.
